sourceScope: Source and tests in the commit containing this evidence; source text hashes normalize CRLF to LF.
supportedInput: Authenticated unexpired envelope; command input contains only planId and planHash of a stored immutable Workflow Draft plan.
safetyContracts: Default suggest requires a fresh human approval bound to request hash, plan hash, authenticated actor, policy revision and expiry.
Policy is human-owned, versioned and persisted; invalid authority hydrates as observe plus global pause.
Global pause blocks every new enqueue including local human approval. Bounded-auto expiry alone downgrades to suggest.
Unsettled estimated exposure never ages away. Hour/day aging starts at first durable exact Queue settlement observation.
One workspace CAS covers approval claims, rolling limits, outstanding client requests and operation-key admission.
Same client operation idempotency key cannot create a new batch by changing request ID.
Immutable grant binding is part of each atomic Queue job snapshot; runId equals deterministic batchId.
After grant consumption, recovery only reads exact Queue facts; absent or unknown outcomes never authorize another enqueue.
Approval cannot rewrite a plan or increase its original budget. Stale source or inadequate plan budget requires explicit replanning.
Current selected Folder cannot replace the reviewed direct output path; selected-folder plans require immutable Folder binding.
Per-job paid consent is narrowed after aggregate batch validation, with the original pricing and approval times.

automatedTests.boundaries: Actual IndexedDB adapters and real Queue transaction tests; Provider executor requests use mocked transport. No live Provider tests ran.
keyCoverage: Concurrent approve once, restart restoration, rejection and exact receipt replay.
Client revocation, expiry, stale plan, policy rebinding and service actor preservation.
Per-run, hourly/day, outstanding and concurrency limits across clients and CAS races.
25-hour blocked Queue exposure, persisted settlement time, uncertain outcomes and operation-key duplication.
Queue commit before receipt failure, failed result projection, exact snapshot/grant reconciliation without a second enqueue.
Policy persistence failure, same-version corrupt hydration, native authentication crossing policy save and foreground stop.
Real paid two-job Queue enqueue/reopen and executor consent validation with mocked transport.

checks: Suggest enqueue is durably pending after ready-file retirement; zero Queue-port calls and reviewed source/cost/output are visible
Actual policy form save increments and durably stores revision; fresh single-use approval enqueues exactly once and publishes exact persisted receipt with existing batch link
Exact envelope replay preserves the completed receipt and makes no second Queue-port call
Human reject finalizes durable rejected receipt without enqueue
New foreground/coordinator instance and settings rehydration restore retired pending approval and policy revision from actual IndexedDB
Explicit mode selection plus future expiry saved through the human form permits an in-budget fixture enqueue
Saved global pause produces pending review and disables approval without enqueue
Advancing only the coordinator clock beyond the persisted auto expiry downgrades new enqueue to pending without a timer or additional Queue call
390px panel and document have no horizontal overflow
browserQA.environment: Actual AgentCommandPanel, AgentPolicyForm, ForegroundAgentCommandRuntime, AgentExecutionCoordinator, settings persistence/hydration and IndexedDB approval/receipt repositories. Native ownership/client/authentication, immutable plan lookup and Queue enqueue/reconcile are fixtures. The expiry scenario advances only the coordinator clock. No Windows keyring, HMAC cryptography, native filesystem inbox, real Queue execution, Provider request, Anlas spending or production profile.
browserQA.visualReview: QA worker inspected the desktop and 390px screenshots; no horizontal overflow.
browserQA.cleanup: Owned Chromium closed and Vite stopped after final QA; the QA worker verified zero listeners on loopback port 9191.

review.method: Independent Queue/application boundary review and root integration; action items fixed before final regression.
resolved: Unsettled grants previously aged out of rolling windows; now require persisted exact settlement evidence.
Operation key was not unique across request IDs; now enforced in admission CAS.
Service actor identity was lost at Queue bridge; now preserved in grant and application actor.
Policy-save pending state was checked only before native authentication; now checked afterward too.
UI global pause disabled approval but core allowed local approval; core now enforces the same pause.
Batch consent was incorrectly applied as single-job consent; aggregate validation plus narrowed per-job consent now passes execution checks.

validationFailures.failure: One old source-contract assertion expected costConsent at the codec call.
validationFailures.resolution: Updated to the intended narrowed jobConsent; final full nonlive suite passes.

validationFailures.failure: Initial isolated browser harness imported a different Vite router module and later raced optimizer reload.
validationFailures.resolution: Harness imports the production router URL and waits for actual Data Hub readiness; final browser QA passes.

limitations: No Phase 9C native Tauri build, actual Windows approval/enqueue GUI QA, installer QA or forced native process crash in this pass.
Phase 9B desktop-native evidence does not prove the new Phase 9C execution path.
Browser native/auth/immutable-plan/Queue ports are fixtures; browser expiry advances the coordinator clock only.
No live Provider, image generation/output, Anlas spending, R2 request or production-profile change.
Counters represent reserved estimated exposure, not actual billed Anlas.
The workspace execution ledger admits at most 1000 records; history is not pruned or silently reset.
Simultaneous failure of policy readback and compensating disabled-policy persistence is not proven by native crash testing.
Folder targets without immutable authority, R2 delivery and pinned credentials remain unsupported where existing planner/Queue gates reject them.
Cancellation, storage/Scene retry, reservation abandonment and other Scene/Folder/R2 mutations remain unavailable.
Phase 10 MCP and Phase 11 background/headless remain unimplemented.
